THE SIKH GURDWARAS (SUPPLEMENTARY) ACT, 1925 
ACT NO. XXIV OF 1925 
[11th September, 1925] 
An Act to supplement certain provisions of the Sikh Gurdwaras Act, 1925 
 WHEREAS it is expedient to supplement, 1[* * *] certain provisions of the Sikh Gurdwaras Act, 1925 
(Punjab Act VIII of 1925), for the purposes hereinafter appearing ; It is hereby enacted as follows:___ 
 1. Short title and commencement.___(1) This Act may be called the Sikh Gurdwaras (Supplementary) 
Act, 1925. 
 (2) It shall come into force on the date 2appointed by the 3[Provincial Government] under sub-section 
(3) of section 1 of the Sikh Gurdwaras Act, 1925(Punjab Act VIII of 1925). 
 2. Validation of certain provisions of Punjab Act VIII of 1925. ___The Sikh Gurdwaras Act, 1925 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), shall, so far as it adds to or tak es from the jurisdiction of the 
High Court 4[* *] at Lahore or prescribes the procedure of the said Court, be as valid as if it had been 
passed by the 5[Central Legislature]. 
 3. 6[Repealed]  
 
________ 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Date: 15-08-2024 
1Omitted by the Federal Laws (Revision and Declaration) Act, 1951 (XXVI of 1951), s. 3 and 2nd Sch. 
2The 1st November, 1925 ; see Punjab Gazette 1925, Pt. I, p, 712. 
3Subs. by the A.O., 1937. 
4Omitted by Central Adaptation of Laws Order, 1964(P. O. 1 of 1964), Art. 2 and Sch.  
5Subs. by the Federal Laws (Revision and Declaration) Act, 1951 (XXVI of 1951), s. 4 and Third Sch.
